name: distance from MA20
notes: further below MA20 -> still falling -> failure

name: new lows in prior 10d
exact_formula: count of days in prior 10 obs with low_adj <= min(low_adj of prior 20 obs before that day)

name: days since latest low
exact_formula: anchor_i - i_of_min(low_adj[prior 20 obs]) (0 if today is new low)

name: ATR20 pct
notes: high vol -> stronger mean reversion (consistent P2)

name: days underwater
exact_formula: count of days entry..anchor with close_adj < entry_adj

name: All-A EW 60d return
exact_formula: ret60_ea (frozen T2-R R01; Discovery Q20/40/60/80 cutpoints)

name: layer count at anchor
exact_formula: number of layers with layer_i <= anchor_i
